content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020 In case of "event" semantic the IocSend function shall return IOC_E_LIMIT if an IOC internal transmission buffer became full (Case: Receiver is slower than sender or/ and configured internal IOC buffer size is too small). If this error occurs the IOC internal buffer could not be filled with the parameter. In that case this error shall produce an IOC_E_LOST_DATA Overlayed Error on the receiver side at the next data reception (s. SWS_Os_00745).
